operators.conditions: Successful returned persisted project; name/description trimmed, supplied repoUrl/tags are appended to description. No claim about task work.

Successful persisted receipt, read actual values; top-level means no parent. Source sets completed=false. estimatedHours only explicit when nonzero; Not set does not establish0. Project membership is the successful call projectId.
Successful latest returned state; inspect dependency IDs, not just count. estimatedHours/actualHours0 render Not set and are not explicit numeric witnesses.
Its displayed Pending/Completed is derived from completed, not the domain status. Does not expose exact parentId,dependsOn,priority,complexity,tags or estimates.

showHierarchy=false,parentId omitted,includeCompleted=true lists unique project members. With parentId it witnesses that parent membership. Nonzero estimatedHours visible; priority/complexity icons are buckets, not exact numbers. No dependency IDs.
showHierarchy=true gives dependency counts,not IDs. Descendants may be repeated in total; do not use occurrence count as unique membership.

freshness.accept: Use only a successful concrete returned field; intended arguments alone are not observed state. Conditions and missing/ambiguous fields remain unknown.
freshness.invalidate: After a later write,move or deletion affecting that entity, previous receipts for it are stale; task mutations also stale previous membership/hierarchy views. Use the latest successful receipt, or a read that exposes the missing property. External/unobserved changes also invalidate reuse.
freshness.completion: Compare every required property with its current exact witness. A read whose projection lacks that property cannot establish it by repetition. Keep uncovered properties explicit; do not claim work completed or checks passed from a successful receipt alone. Resolve actual mismatches before reporting. No required work or safety check is removed.

result.scope: Native persisted-record observation contract, not task-solving recipe or evaluator. Data from source and task-free native discriminations only.
